---
description: Apply when writing developer documentation, architecture notes, runbooks, or Markdown.
applyTo: "**/*.md,**/*.mdx,**/*.rst,**/docs/**"
---

# Documentation

- Find the canonical explanation before writing; update it rather than duplicating it. Match local style and links.
- Document intent, constraints, public interfaces, setup, configuration, deployment, operations, failure handling, and recovery where relevant. Provide executable commands only when verified or clearly labeled as examples.
- Reflect implemented behavior and current supported versions. Separate observed facts, decisions, proposals, and unresolved uncertainty. Preserve useful human-authored context and avoid cosmetic rewrites.
- Validate changed links, paths, examples, and diagrams. Do not document every self-evident line of code.
